resources.string: Unlocks a louder maximum volume for calls.
Please wait while call volume settings are restored.
%1$s allows call volume to exceed the device’s stock maximum. High volume may damage the speaker or even damage your hearing. Use with caution.
%1$s raises only the highest call-volume steps in the Mudita Kompakt’s MediaTek runtime speech-volume tables, then asks the audio system to reload them.

The increase is deliberately modest because the app works within the device’s existing audio path and known stable gain range. It does not replace the amplifier, rewrite vendor calibration, or bypass hardware limits. Larger gains may be ignored, cause distortion, behave unpredictably, or increase the risk of damage to the speaker or your hearing.

Changes affect call audio only and reset when the device restarts. “%1$s” restores enabled volume unlocks after startup. This behavior is specific to the Mudita Kompakt and may not work on other devices.
Testing has been limited to the Mudita Kompakt running MuditaOS K 1.5.

%1$s respects your privacy. %1$s does not collect, transmit, sell, share, or otherwise process personal information outside your device.
The app stores your preferences locally on your device so that it can remember your settings. These preferences are used only to provide the app’s functionality.
The developer cannot access these locally stored preferences, and the app does not transmit them to the developer or any third party.
You can remove the locally stored preferences by uninstalling the app.
%1$s does not contain advertising, analytics, tracking technologies, or third-party services that collect information through the app.
This policy applies only to %1$s. Your device and its operating system may process information independently under their own privacy policies.
%1$s does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children.
If the app’s privacy practices change, this policy will be updated and the effective date above will be revised.
